**Head of Engineering, Noah Bennett -** As Head of Engineering, Noah leads the team building Tessera's multi-tenant SaaS platform and is responsible for secure-by-default development practice. He is creative and pragmatic, but constantly trades delivery speed against control. TSR-INC-2025-031 traced straight back to engineering: an engineer committed a long-lived AWS access key into a misconfigured public repository, and pre-commit secret scanning did not catch it. Noah is now hardening the SDLC - secret management, pre-commit hooks, repo-visibility controls and automated security testing - while still shipping.

**Interview Focus: Head of Engineering Noah Bennett**
Students should probe the development-side failures behind the breach. Useful questions: how a long-lived key reached a public repo and why secret scanning missed it; how secure-coding standards hold up under deadline pressure; how he is embedding security into the SDLC; the balance between fixing legacy risk and securing new code; how code review and automated testing are changing; and how third-party and dependency risk is managed.
